title: Aloe-Emodin Interaction Study with Human Telomeric G-Quadruplex DNA under K+ and Na+ Conditions.
authors: Kumari, Priya; Sengar, Manish S; Pandav, Kumud; Barthwal, Ritu; Kumar, Surat; Chandel, Arvind K Singh
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦荟大黄素与小分子G-四链体DNA的相互作用，采用光谱和对接方法，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但非TF-DNA，且方法以实验为主、对接仅辅助，故归为中等匹配。
abstract: Aloe-emodin (AED), a naturally occurring anthraquinone, was examined for its interaction with two model human telomeric G-quadruplex systems: wHTel26 adopting a hybrid-2 topology in K+-containing buffer and HTel22 adopting an antiparallel basket topology in Na+-containing buffer. UV-visible absorption, fluorescence, and circular dichroism spectroscopy showed concentration-dependent changes consistent with AED association with both G4 models. The apparent binding constants varied among the analytical techniques, spanning approximately 103 M-1-105 M-1, reflecting the distinct optical and conformational observables monitored by each method and the non-linear nature of the titration profiles. The limited wavelength shifts and preservation of the major CD signatures were consistent with a non-intercalative interaction, although the precise binding geometry and stoichiometry could not be resolved. AED produced an apparent thermal stabilization of approximately 14  degrees C for wHTel26 under the tested K+ condition, whereas no comparable stabilization was observed for HTel22 under the tested Na+ condition. Because the systems differed simultaneously in sequence, flanking residues, topology, and cation, this difference cannot be attributed solely to the ionic environment. Docking generated plausible AED association poses was used only as supportive, hypothesis-generating evidence. AED also reduced MCF-7 metabolic viability with an estimated IC50 of 18.82 microM; however, telomerase inhibition and intracellular G4 target engagement were not investigated. Thus, establishing sequence- and cation-controlled G4 selectivity and confirming intracellular target engagement remain important challenges. Future studies employing matched-sequence/cross-cation comparisons, direct cellular G4-target engagement, and telomerase-based mechanistic assays will be required to establish the molecular and biological significance of AED-G4 interactions.
abstract_zh: 芦荟大黄素（Aloe-emodin, AED），一种天然存在的蒽醌类化合物，被研究其与两种模型人端粒G-四链体（G-quadruplex）系统的相互作用：在含K⁺缓冲液中采用hybrid-2拓扑结构的wHTel26，以及在含Na⁺缓冲液中采用反平行篮状拓扑结构的HTel22。紫外-可见吸收光谱、荧光光谱和圆二色光谱显示，浓度依赖性变化与AED与两种G4模型的结合一致。表观结合常数在不同分析技术间有所差异，范围约为10³ M⁻¹至10⁵ M⁻¹，反映了每种方法监测的不同光学和构象可观测指标，以及滴定曲线的非线性特征。有限的波长位移和主要CD特征信号的保留与非插入式相互作用一致，但精确的结合几何构型和化学计量比未能确定。在测试的K⁺条件下，AED对wHTel26产生了约14°C的表观热稳定性提升，而在测试的Na⁺条件下，对HTel22未观察到类似的稳定性提升。由于系统在序列、侧翼残基、拓扑结构和阳离子方面同时存在差异，这一差异不能仅归因于离子环境。对接生成的合理AED结合姿态仅作为支持性、假设生成的证据使用。AED还降低了MCF-7代谢活力，估计IC₅₀为18.82 μM；然而，端粒酶抑制和细胞内G4靶点参与未被研究。因此，建立序列和阳离子控制的G4选择性以及确认细胞内靶点参与仍是重要挑战。未来研究需采用匹配序列/交叉阳离子比较、直接细胞G4靶点参与以及基于端粒酶的机制分析，以确定AED-G4相互作用的分子和生物学意义。
